title: ciudad juarez contract and procurement opportunities - u.s. embassy & consulates in mexico
paragraphs: to all sales representatives/vendors/contractors in ciudad juarez and its consular district. below are the current contract opportunities. qualified offerors holding requisite permits and licenses to do business in mexico, and interested in any of these opportunities must follow the specific instructions that are provided for each opportunity. the deadlines are finite. please use the below links for further information regarding the solicitation(s). all potential offerors who respond to any request for quotation must be technically qualified and financially responsible to perform the work. prospective offerors must register with the system for award management unless it’s impractical to do so in accordance with far 4.1102 policy at the following website:  system for award management (sam) at www.sam.gov .  registration at sam.gov is mandatory to be considered for all acquisitions at or exceeding $30,000 usd. attached is a quick reference guide for registering into the system for award management (sam). quick guide for sam registration.
